children: reported second fiscal quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $875.7 million, up 9% year-over-year. The company posted GAAP net income of $77.7 million (GAAP diluted EPS $0.40) and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.16. Management raised fiscal 2027 guidance for revenue, ARR growth and expects IAM to represent ~18–19% of total ARR exiting Q4.
Revenue: $875.7 million for the quarter, a 9% year-over-year increase (including ~1.3% FX benefit).
Gross profit and margin: GAAP gross margin 79.7%; non-GAAP gross margin 81.7% for the quarter.
Operating income: GAAP income from operations $117.6 million for the quarter.
Net income and EPS: GAAP net income $77.7 million; GAAP diluted EPS $0.40; non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.16 (on 193 million diluted shares).

Cash flow and balance sheet: Net cash provided by operating activities $334.5 million for the quarter; free cash flow $295.8 million (34% margin); cash, cash equivalents and investments $973.1 million at quarter end.

Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) momentum: IAM represented 15.1% of total ARR as of July 31, 2026, up from 12.6% at April 30, 2026; company expects IAM to represent ~18–19% of total ARR exiting Q4 FY27.

AI and agentic capabilities launched: Introduced agentic tools powered by Iris (contract-specific AI) including an AI assistant for contract analysis, pre-built agents (agreement intake, vendor renewal), and an Agent Studio for building/governing custom agents.

Integration and ecosystem expansion: Released Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and expanded MCP integrations (Slack app, Perplexity, Gemini Enterprise connector), alongside connectors for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, and Microsoft Copilot.

Product integration: Integrated Agreement Manager into Docusign CLM to create an AI-powered repository turning static files into searchable business insights for risk identification and cost-saving opportunities.
Share repurchases: Executed $306.5 million of common stock repurchases during the quarter, reflecting continued use of the repurchase program.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Docusign raises FY27 guidance as Q2 revenue hits $875.7M; IAM now 15.1% of ARR
